Astryx CLI
Commands, programmatic APIs, and output contracts. Building an integration is under `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs
authoring`.

package: @astryxdesign/cli

Use the CLI in any folder: install it once for your computer, and every project still gets the release that matches its Core. See `npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs global`.

Guides

component-lookups                 Look up one or several exact component identities, choose a focused projection, and
                                  handle complete batch receipts.
host-entry                        Run the Astryx CLI from your own command-line tool: the inputs `runHostedCli` takes,
                                  what it returns, and when the process ends instead.

api/schemas                       Data shapes, field by field.
api/schemas/output                Output Envelope: The single JSON envelope every command emits under --json. Success is
                                  { apiVersion, type, package?, data, meta? }; failure is { apiVersion, error, code,
                                  suggestions? }. Discriminate by checking whether `error` is present.
api/enums                         Every fixed list of values, such as error codes and response types.
api/enums/error-codes             Error Codes: Stable, append-only machine-readable error codes on the --json error
                                  envelope (envelope.code). Codes never change or get removed; branch on these, not on
                                  prose.
api/enums/response-types          Response Types: The `type` discriminant present on every --json success envelope.
